description: Repository binding and model and effort policy for the agent workflows. agenticool-agents generates and syncs the agent files from it.

issue-creation.summary: Plan, draft, classify, and publish issues in the main thread

issue-triage.summary: Independent read-only classification, decomposition, and dependency judgment of drafted issues, when filing needs it

implementation.summary: Delegated leaf delivery and PR rework through ready-for-review PRs; advisory only for explicit inline delivery

code-review.summary: Read-only review against acceptance criteria and exact SHAs

claude.description: Model aliases accepted by the Agent tool and subagent frontmatter, with the effort levels each supports. Full IDs matching modelIdPattern are accepted with the same effort levels.

codex.description: Model slugs accepted by spawn_agent, with the reasoning efforts each supports. Keep this in step with the Codex model catalog (`codex debug models`).

assessmentOrder: Name a concrete unresolved correctness question
Inspect only relevant evidence when needed
Try an existing pattern, focused test, or smaller reviewable step
Apply a rule only with evidence and why medium with the written plan is insufficient

H1-boundary.description: Design or prove a new security, immutable-evidence, persistent-data, or compatibility guarantee across components. The ticket/spec leaves the mechanism unresolved. Applying an established specified pattern does not qualify.

H2-coupled-design.description: An algorithm, state machine, concurrency protocol, or migration has interacting correctness constraints unresolved by the supplied design. File count, Size L, and multiple consumers do not qualify.

H3-demonstrated-limit.description: A medium attempt produced a reproducible correctness failure or substantive review finding requiring an underlying design revision. Routine test, formatting, environment failures, first unsuccessful attempts, and review counts do not qualify. Retry and two-round review limits still apply.
